title: Payment notice and file store choices
decision: A notice lapses after 14 days; at most three open notices a customer; a customer may send one to a limited or suspended shop; accepting from the chat takes one tap; image receipts are checked by structure and stripped of metadata without re-encoding pixels, and PDF receipts are kept as sent; a duplicate is detected only among files still stored in the same shop and shown only to staff; the upload route alone may receive up to 5 MB; links are signed with a key derived from the one server secret, which is now required for receipts to open
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 36
rationale: The specification gives the limits of a file and that links are signed, not how a file is judged safe or where a duplicate is looked for
